goal: Naming review: names that say what a value or function does, and match the domain.
use: Naming review: names that say what a value or function does, and match the domain. Use when code names are added or renamed.

steps.note: List names. Collect the new variables, functions and types in the change.
Flag vague names. Data, tmp, info, handler, manager, flag.
Flag misleading names. A name that says one thing and does another.
Check consistency. The same concept should keep one name across the change.
Report. Each name with file and line, the problem and a better name.
